mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 4.5% compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate lower financing costs.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS declines below 4.5% yet SPX 5-day returns are negative in >60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 2-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate falling below 4.0% signals labor market tightening, accelerating corporate hiring and profit growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: UNRATE < 4.0% yet SPX 20-day returns negative in >60% of instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 for the trigger condition.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous 1.0%+ monthly increases in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate robust consumer spending, boosting corporate revenue visibility and positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: HOUST and RSAFS both rise >1.0% yet SPX 60-day returns negative in >60% of cases, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) exceeding 105.0 during post-recession recovery signals manufacturing sector strength, supporting corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: INDPRO > 105.0 in post-recession recovery yet SPX 20-day returns negative in >60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Rising CPIAUCSL above 315.0 indicates accelerating inflation, prompting central bank hawkishness that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 315.0 yet SPX 20-day returns positive in >60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 for the series.

mechanism_narrative: Quarterly GDP growth exceeding 1.5% signals robust economic expansion, accelerating corporate revenue growth and positive S&P 500 returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 growth > 1.5% yet SPX 5-day returns negative in >60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 for the trigger.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent monthly employment growth (PAYEMS > 100k) and unemployment decline (UNRATE < 0.2pp) indicate labor market tightness, driving higher corporate profit margins and positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS > 100k and UNRATE decline > 0.2pp yet SPX 60-day returns negative in >60% of cases, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 1,300,000 units during housing market recovery signals consumer confidence in durable goods, boosting equity valuations and positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: HOUST > 1300 in housing recovery yet SPX 20-day returns negative in >60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 for the regime.
